subject: Hosted API fit assessment & devops checklist
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finlytics.com>, Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API fit assessment & devops checklist

Hi Alicia / Jacob —

Thanks again for the time today — great demo and really helpful context on the fraud-scoring flow. I pulled together a short checklist to make sure we scope the right evaluation path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) and provision an initial sandbox for your infra team. Attached: redwood-hosted-quickstart-checklist.pdf and a rough network-egress-estimate.xlsx.

Quick recap / asks (can you confirm by EOD Thu?):
- Preferred evaluation mode: (Hosted evaluation sandbox / Dedicated reserved capacity / Private VPC on-prem) — you mentioned Hosted as default but wanted to confirm.
- Data residency & compliance: must be US-only? any additional compliance (SOC 2 type II, PCI, HIPAA)?
- Traffic profile: steady qps, expected peak bursts (req/s), avg tokens generated per response, % embeddings vs generation.
- Latency SLO: p95 target and any hard limits for customer-facing latency.
- Network/egress: do you have strict IP allowlists or egress routing through VPC/NAT? who owns ingress rules?
- Sandbox ops: who should we send sandbox creds to (infra contact email)?

Proposed quickstart for Hosted evaluation (if Hosted fits):
1) We provision a sandbox endpoint and an ops runbook (3 business days).
2) Baseline rate caps (we'll propose a starting slice) and a burst policy to support demo spikes.
3) Enable prefix/KV caching recommendations and example prompt set for quality monitoring.

Next steps: if Hosted is ok, we can spin up a sandbox and map endpoints for your devs. If you need private/Dedicated, we’ll gather additional procurement/security contacts and timeline.

Thanks — appreciate the quick confirmation.

– Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments:
- redwood-hosted-quickstart-checklist.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
- network-egress-estimate.xlsx (XLSX, stub)
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finlytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@finlytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T18:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API fit assessment & devops checklist

Thanks Karthik — great summary. Quick answers inline: 

- Preferred evaluation mode: Hosted evaluation sandbox (we prefer to try Hosted first; Dedicated/Private only if isolation or egress policy forces it).
- Data residency & compliance: US-only for production datasets. We require SOC 2 (Type II) for any production rollout; for evaluation, a SOC 2 attestation is sufficient. No HIPAA/PCI for this initial scope.
- Traffic profile: baseline ~40 req/s during business hours, average response ~30 tokens, peak event bursts up to ~120 req/s sustained for 5–10 minutes. Embeddings use is minimal (<10%).
- Latency SLO: target p95 <= 350ms for single-request scoring; hard limit 800ms.
- Network/egress: we will use IP allowlist. Jacob (cc'd) is our infra lead and will share the allowlist once we have the sandbox IPs.
- Sandbox ops contact: Jacob Lee (jacob.lee@finlytics.com).

Two asks for you: (1) Can Redwood support prefix/KV caching for our scoring prompt to reduce tokens? (2) What's the default hosted rate-limit policy for sandbox endpoints (baseline + burst)?

Attaching a small network-estimate we ran — should help size the egress (network-egress-estimate.xlsx).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow if it helps.

— Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product, Finlytics
alicia.gomez@finlytics.com | +1 617-555-0133
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finlytics.com>, Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T20:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API fit assessment & devops checklist

Appreciate the fast answers, Alicia — this is perfect. Quick responses to your two asks and proposed next steps: 

1) Prefix / KV caching: yes — our runtime supports prefix and KV caching for deterministic scoring prompts. We'll include caching rules in the sandbox runbook and an example config that reduces per-response token counts substantially.

2) Default hosted sandbox rate-limit policy (what we propose for your trial):
   - Baseline slice: 100 req/s per sandbox endpoint (sustained), with per-token billing as usual.
   - Burst policy: auto-burst to 200 req/s for short windows (rate-decayed over 10–15 minutes).
   - Per-route quotas: we can set separate quotas for scoring vs other API calls (embeddings) — useful to isolate budgets.

If those numbers look ok we'll:
- Ben will provision the sandbox endpoints and create the allowlist entries (Ben: can you provision and share IPs + credentials with Jacob?).
- Marissa will attach the quickstart runbook and a few sample prompt sets for quality monitoring.
- We can schedule a 30-min post-provisioning call with Jacob to validate traffic and run a short load profile test.

Proposed times for provisioning call: Thu 10/7 10:00–10:30 PT or Fri 10/8 11:00–11:30 PT — tell us what works for you.

Linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/8427

Thanks —
Karthik
